dedupe_keys.name: data and code for improving hydrological modelling of urban drainage swales using through use of soil water content observations

description: A Luleå University of Technology team publishes field observations and MIKE SHE model outputs for an urban drainage swale. Zenodo provides one archive under CC BY 4.0. The stated measured variables are rainfall, swale outflow and soil-water content. Simulated outflow and soil-water content and the study code accompany them. These paired series can calibrate infiltration and retention components of stormwater simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this swale experiment. Coverage is the instrumented swale and observation period used in the article; the own-page summary does not state exact site coordinates or full sampling frequency. A limitation is that modelled responses are not independent field measurements, and soil-water probes may not represent the whole swale. Reuse of MIKE SHE model files may depend on separate software. The archive was not downloaded and no water balance or calibration score was reproduced.
